title: Review Payload
description: The exact GitHub PR review that would be posted: built once, stored content-addressed, approved as a specific artifact, posted verbatim. What a human approves is byte-for-byte what goes out.

line.description: The anchor line on the head revision — always a line the diff added, or GitHub rejects the comment.

startLine.description: Present only when the finding's whole span consists of added lines: the comment then attaches to the range startLine..line.

event.description: Always COMMENT — approving or requesting changes is a human decision this tool never makes.
